01 /

Card deposits

If enabled, choose Stripe in your wallet and continue to hosted checkout. EDGE credits a deposit only after verified payment confirmation. A return URL, screenshot or incomplete checkout is not proof of a paid deposit.

02 /

Manual deposits

Choose an enabled manual method and follow its current image, name and payment instructions. Submit the payment reference for review. An administrator verifies the external transfer before adding funds. Do not send money to details copied from an unofficial message.

03 /

Requesting a withdrawal

Your KYC must be approved. Choose an available withdrawal method and complete the recipient fields it requires. Check every detail before confirming. The current deposit and withdrawal minimum is $100, and the amount must be available in your wallet.

04 /

Review and payment status

A withdrawal request reserves its amount immediately. The administrator reviews and completes the external payout, then records the outcome and reference. If rejected, the reserved funds return to your wallet. The platform does not initiate automatic bank transfers or Stripe withdrawals.

05 /

Timing, costs and questions

Processing depends on the payment method, external provider and administrator review. EDGE does not promise an instant payout or a fixed completion time. Review provider charges and any conversion costs before paying. If something looks wrong, contact support with the relevant reference.
